defects.title: Checkpoint wrapper rejects existing snapshot-capable nested artifact
defects.symptom: A returning developer cannot save the runtime checkpoint for a legal nested requirements artifact.
defects.boundary: snapshot() succeeds; exportCheckpoint body hashing fails.
defects.mechanism: contentHash(body) and clone(savedCheckpoint) apply the 15-level portable value envelope to the additional checkpoint.state wrapper. A depth-10 content object fits createArtifact and snapshot but reaches depth 16 in the checkpoint.
defects.upstreamCause: Local checkpoint serialization reused the per-value provider envelope validator without accounting for checkpoint bookkeeping depth.
defects.missingGuard: Checkpoint tests exercise small scalar payloads and collection count but omit existing legal nesting boundaries.
defects.smallestRepair: Normalize envelope metadata and state/retry subtrees separately, then canonical-hash the bounded local checkpoint without charging bookkeeping wrappers to subtree depth. maxNestingDepth overrides above 15 are rejected. Preserve current shallow checkpoint hashes, descriptor-safe import copying, byte/collection ceilings, owner matching and all shape/reference checks; do not raise global provider depth or reduce accepted payload depth.
